utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I’m catching up late as usual—can you confirm the needs list before Friday, especially anything safety-related, and also help me verify the exact drive timing and location?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Dane—I’m confirming the repair needs and flagging any safety items first, then I’ll check the exact timing and location and send you the verified details before Friday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo—that’s perfect. Once you send it, I’ll pass the confirmed list along and mark anything that needs to carry over to Sunday’s safety fixes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Uli — I’ve got the repair drive logged for Saturday, 10 to 2 in the community room, taking small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing, with no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I’ll quietly pass that along today, and if anyone mentions tools or a repair request, I’ll send the details to Sam and Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks Uli — please keep the date and location as Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and send me any requests too so I can keep the list current.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, I’m still trying to pin down who has the list; Mara says the drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, so can you help with intake, repairs, or sorting if I confirm what’s needed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, Mina, I can help with intake or sorting once you confirm the list with Hana or whoever has it. I’ll hold off on assuming the repair needs until we know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Nell—please plan on intake or sorting Saturday 10 to 2, and I’ll tell you once I confirm who has the list and what gaps are real.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tomorrow morning drop-off is at the hall; after lunch we sort, then tackle safety fixes first. Gus will be out front before 9 with labeled cords and tools—check in with him there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, got it—hall in the morning, sorting after lunch, safety fixes first. I’ll find Gus out front before 9 and try not to wander off before checking in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Bring your cord box too, and start a simple list of what comes in before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, I’m still piecing it together—small appliances are definitely on the list, Gus is bringing tools at 9 Saturday, and Eli’s confirming which lamps and chairs still need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That helps, Ira—small appliances, Gus with tools at 9, and Eli checking lamps and chairs, got it. I’ll pass that along to Hana’s main list and keep asking about clipboards, sorting space, and drop-off help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess—please tell Hana that’s all I’ve got confirmed so far, and if you hear who can cover drop-off or sorting space, send it my way so I can update Mina.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus—quick version, I’m in for one repair-drive slot, and I can help with pickup too if Faye sends the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great, Bo—pickup help will be handy. I’ll be out front before 9 with my toolbox, drill, socket set, and labeled extension cords, so check in with Noah when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll check in with Noah when I get there, and I’m still waiting on Faye for the exact pickup time and place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Rey, that’s perfect—two extension cords and your small toolkit, labeled with your name. I’ll jot it down before my brain sets it on a bus somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Oren—I’ll label the two extension cords and my small toolkit and bring them Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thank you, Rey—that’s a huge help. Saturday morning for the repair drive, and I’ll add your cords and toolkit to my list before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect, Faye — I’ll put you down for the late morning shift from 10 to noon, and we’ll keep the afternoon clear for your family time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — 10 to noon works for me, and I’ll make sure I’m wrapped up before pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wonderful, thanks Faye — I’ve got you confirmed for 10 to noon, and we’ll make sure you’re free to head out on time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m glad folks are pitching in, but can we make sure drop-offs stay at the front table before lunch and that Cleo’s request list is the one we sort from?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — drop-offs will stay at the front table before lunch, and we’ll sort from Cleo’s request list so safety fixes stay first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, thank you—I'll remind anyone who asks to take request details to Cleo and keep repair items to the front table until sorting after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I’m still waiting on Eli’s exact repair list, but I’m trying to match spare hands and tools across the different groups—do you know anyone who could help once we set the spot?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes—once the spot’s confirmed, I can help connect spare hands and tools, and I’ll be at the Sunday community center drive for check-in too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Sam—thank you. I’ll confirm the spot once I have Eli’s list, and I’ll count on you for Sunday check-in and matching helpers with tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, I’ve got the repair drive list in order: Gus is dropping tools Saturday at 9, and the drive itself is Sunday at the community center. I’m still confirming the lamps, chairs, and small appliances so we can assign tables cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Eli, hold on—are you sure it’s Sunday at the community center? I had the repair drive down as Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room, so I need a firm confirmation before I update anyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You’re right to question it, Kira—I’ll confirm the date and room with Sam before anyone updates notices. Until then, keep it as pending so we don’t send mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Hana! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, for small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing, but no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll note Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, with no hazardous items. Do you know yet which repairs are already reported as urgent or which have volunteers lined up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I don’t have the urgent list or volunteer lineup confirmed yet, Hana, but I’m asking around and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear for sure.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Sam, I’m helping sort the repair drive list—do you have any reported repairs to add, and can you note which ones are safety-related, urgent, or already have a volunteer?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes—I'll add the ones I know and mark anything electrical, heating, or broken steps as safety-related or urgent, plus note any volunteer already lined up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — that detail helps a lot. Please send those over when you can, and I’ll keep electrical, heating, and broken steps near the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Faye, do you have the current repair list or pickup time yet, and who’s already covered so we don’t double-book anyone?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ve got Hana asking for the repair list and urgent notes, Rey asking what to bring, and Bo available for a quick ask; I can cover Saturday 10 to 2 around pickup, but I’m still confirming the exact pickup window before I lock assignments.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, don’t lock Bo in twice—can you send me the pickup window and the current repair list as soon as you have them, and tell Rey to hold off until we know what tools are actually needed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Noah—just quietly passing it along that the repair drive is coming together today. If you’ve got a broken item to bring or any tools to lend, I can pass the details to Sam.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—today, right, thanks Uli. I’ve got my box of busted cords and I think Gus has tools covered, but please tell Sam I may need her to keep me pointed at the right table.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah—I’ll let Sam know you’re bringing the cords and might need a little direction at the table. Glad Gus may have tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Oren, I’ll have the appliance labels and supply notes ready for you Saturday morning—small appliances are confirmed, and Gus should bring tools at 9.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo—small appliances Saturday morning, labels and notes with you, and Gus tools at 9; I’m writing that down before it escapes me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s exactly it, Oren—if anything changes before Saturday, I’ll update the notes and flag it for you when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Jules! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, for small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing, but no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Quinn—thanks for getting the details out. I’m still waiting on Eli’s fix-list, but I’ll point folks toward Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room and remind them no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep sharing the confirmed details and note that Eli’s fix-list is still coming, so folks don’t get mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Dane, I’m checking around on the repair drive logistics now—clipboards, sorting space, and drop-off help. If you hear any new gaps from Hana’s list, send them my way and I’ll pass the word along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I’m still catching up, but I’m checking with Hana before I claim anything. I’ll send you any confirmed gaps, especially if they affect clipboards, sorting space, or drop-off help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Dane—once Hana confirms, I’ll help spread only the firm gaps so we don’t send folks chasing the wrong things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo—that helps. I’ll bring my items to the front table tomorrow morning, but should we label each one with a name and phone number so Rosa can track them properly?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—label each item with name, phone, and the issue. Leave them at the front table; Rosa will log them before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that makes me feel better—I'll label mine clearly and remind a couple neighbors to do the same so Rosa isn't sorting mystery items.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rey — I’ve got the repair drive confirmed for Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, taking small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing, with no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll bring labeled basic tools, gloves, spare screws, and patch supplies Saturday, and I’ll keep the no-hazardous-items rule in mind.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rey — I’ll note you for tools, gloves, screws, and patch supplies in the community room setup list for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Vik, I’m still getting the repair drive details second-hand—have you heard whether Hana’s keeping the main list, or what gaps are still biggest?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I haven’t heard whether Hana has the main list yet; I only know we’re collecting broken small appliances and Oren’s sorting and labeling. I’ll check back with Mina and pass along the gaps once she confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik—that helps. I’ll treat the appliance sorting as tentative for now and wait for whatever Mina confirms about the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we’re starting with safety fixes first. Could you help direct folks to the right repair tables once they check in?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Rosa, I can direct folks after check-in on Sunday. I’ll keep the list orderly and route safety fixes first, then lamps, chairs, and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Eli—that order is exactly right. I’ll make sure you have the updated needs list from Cleo before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Kira, I’m helping Mina firm up the repair drive list—so far I’ve heard Gus is bringing tools at 9 Saturday, Oren’s sorting labels, and Cleo’s collecting repair requests; do you know anything else that needs fixing or anyone else signed up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’ve got firm yeses from Oren for 10 to 2 and Sam for Saturday, and Faye said yes for 10 to 2 as long as she may need to step out for pickup timing. Bo still hasn’t given me a firm confirmation, so don’t count him yet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira—that helps a lot; I’ll pass Mina the firm yeses for Oren, Sam, and Faye with that pickup caveat, and I won’t count Bo until he confirms.
